decisions.label: Let a long table be searched
decisions.why: 1 table runs to fifteen rows or more, so finding one row means reading every row. The theme already loads the search behaviour on every page and switches it on for any table marked this way — 26 tables across the site already are, including the contact directory. It adds a search box, a length menu and a pager, and makes the column headings sortable; ten rows show at a time, which is the library's own default. 1 of them open on the most recent row, because the first column is a date that sorts — the rest are left in the order they were written.
